name: io.github.juliangeymonat-jpg/wikimoth
description: Deterministic, token-minimal memory for Claude and agents over a [[wikilink]] markdown vault: multi-hop recall with no LLM call in the retrieval loop, local and private, pure-stdlib Python. Tools: recall, status, plus a memory-hygiene suite (conflicts, lint, duplicates, fading, supersede).
